SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-24-2018 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO SEP-13-2018 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506 PLAINTIFF JAMES ADES IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF'S TESTIMONY ALLUDED TO A PRIOR ACTION IN UNLAWFUL DETAINER COURT. UPON RESEARCHING RELATED CASE 660171, JPT JEAN MILEFF COULD NOT CONFIRM WHETHER OR NOT PLAINTIFF'S ALLEGATIONS IN THIS CLAIM WERE BARRED BY "RES JUDICATA" IN CASE #660171 AS THE STIPULATION FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT AND JUDGMENT ARE NOT CLEAR AS TO WHAT WAS INCLUDED IN THAT SETTLEMENT/AWARD TO JAMES ADES. DESPITE PLAINTIFF'S OBJECTION, MATTER CONTINUED ON COURT'S OWN MOTION FOR PLAINTIFF TO FILE AN AMENDED MONEY CLAIM INDICATING ALLEGATIONS NOT ASSOCIATED WITH UNLAWFUL DETAINER CASE 660171. PLAINTIFF IS GRANTED REQUEST TO APPEAR BY TELEPHONIC APPEARANCE CITING A HARDSHIP TO RETURN FOR COURT AS PLAINTIFF IS MOVING RESIDENCY OUTSIDE OF SAN FRANCISCO COUNTY. HOWEVER, PLAINTIFF IS REQUIRED TO SUBMIT REQUEST FOR TELEPHONIC APPEARANCE FORM WITH CLERK'S OFFICE AND MUST FOLLOW ALL THE RULES AND REGULATIONS ASSOCIATED WITH TELEPHONICALLY APPEARING. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
